integrity: Standalone Python standard-library verifier and full elementary proof are provided. Generated evidence has no independent validation.
mathematical_claim_scope: All inclusion-minimal super dominating sets of labelled simple cycles with at least three vertices: exact five-gap language, bivariate rational coefficient enumerator, largest cardinality in each order and equality counts at multiples of seven.
scientific_limitations: The prior 2022 cycle enumeration counts minimum-size, not all inclusion-minimal, sets. A potentially relevant 2024 super domination polynomial paper was accessible in abstract/metadata only; publication priority is provisional. Finite enumeration is corroboration and is not an infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Inclusion-minimal super domination on cycles: a five-gap census and sharp seven-period upper spectrum
